Jet.RetiredIntegerTooLarge

*Retired* (was: integer too large for 64 bits)

What

*Retired* (was: integer too large for 64 bits)

Why

Default `Int` literals preserve their exact source value; fixed-width literals use Jet.IntegerOutOfRange

Fix

Do not use Jet.RetiredIntegerTooLarge
